{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Black Redoubt''''' was a secret deep space encampment used by the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. This major facility was the primary repair and resupply base for Alliance forces. The ''Redoubt'' was defended by a minimum of two dozen [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force|Galactic Alliance warships]], as well as a [[Golan VIII space defense platform]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
